short: Its YouTube mining scaled on in later work, but Table 1 holds data fixed; the phoneme+WFST decoder had 2016-17 priors; zero-shot LRS3 changes everything at once: standard.
position: M02, M06 and M07 changed, all standard. M02: 3,886 h exceeds every earlier sentence-level corpus in the ledger (pattern match, 59 studies before 2018-01; earlier corpora about 7-246 h), and the same YouTube-mining line later reached 31k h and 33.6% zero-shot LRS3 WER, but Table 1 retrains baselines on fixed data and Table 2 changes data, model, decoder and LM at once, so the data effect is never measured. M06: Thangthai and Harvey 2017 (DNN-HMM + Kaldi WFST, visual-only) and Sanabria et al. 2016 (CTC + Eesen WFSTs, video-only scored in visemes) built the decoder before; what is new is a visual-only CTC phoneme model decoded to words, with a 3.2-point WER gain over characters on one test set. M07: a unigram-dictionary ablation shows the 5-gram's value, but its text is unnamed and the vocabulary-extension claim is untested. M12: human subsets and viewing conditions differ from the model test; no repeated training runs.
